TIMOTHY ERNEST FEY 1957 - 2012 It is with great sadness, that we announce the passing of Timothy (Tim) Fey. Tim was predeceased by his father Ernie. Tim leaves to mourn his wife of 27 years, Laurie, daughter Stacey, sons Kyle and Sean, granddaughter Dolche, mother Vicky, brother Brian, sister Valerie, and many other relatives and friends. Tim was an avid outdoorsman, and spent a lot of his spare time enjoying the outdoors with friends and family. Tim was born and raised in Winnipeg, but moved to the country shortly after his marriage to Laurie and built their dream home. It was there they raised their daughter and two sons. Tim will be dearly missed by all who loved him. Respecting Tim's wishes, there will be a private service in the Grand Marais area followed by a private gathering of family and friends to celebrate Tim's life.

As published in the Winnipeg Free Press on February 08, 2012
